label: The stance requires a reason why the target fact obtains
paraphrase: P1 of the parity argument, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the stance requires, as a condition of accepting the target fact (in the naturalist instance, that God exists; in the theist instance, that a contingent being exists), a reason why it obtains (ONTIC, the #755 explains), so that, meeting its demand, it rejects the target posited with no reason. It is not the epistemic demand for a reason to accept the target. No person or author is said to hold it.
